accounting.rule: every fill kept with qty/price/fee/rate/kind/time; gross and net realized R stored separately on the fixed risk-amount basis; EOD closes labeled, never blended silently; venues reported separately, no pooling

disaster_stop.rule: none placed; reference stop is sizing reference only

protocol.engine: shared PortfolioEngine + MockExchange + PortfolioManager (no parallel simulator)

entry.fill: next_M15_open * (1 + slippage_rate) via shared MockExchange market slippage
entry.timing: adapter defers the signal one candle; entry action carries the next open

fees.fee_formula: shared MockExchange executor: qty * price * rate; maker on limit TP, taker on market

protocol.name: core-v2.1-engine-backtest-v1

overlap.rule: one open position per strategy+symbol; extra entries OVERLAP_SKIPPED, signal machine unaffected

signals.rule: locked CoreV21 evaluator over locked point-in-time replay frames; A_PLUS_LONG and PULLBACK_LONG open positions; state machine advances during positions so re-arm stays deterministic

sizing.config_source: shared config.yaml risk + backtest blocks (no V2-only block)
sizing.entry_price_basis: actual next-open order price (reference sim used reference close)
sizing.implementation: shared PositionSizer via TradeExecutor (soft_sl=reference stop, no hard SL placed)

strategy_stop.exit_fill: remaining quantity at following M15 open * (1 - slippage_rate) via ClosePosition at the next open
strategy_stop.same_candle_tp: TP limit fills already standing in the trigger/exit candle are kept; the reference simulator ignored them (explained difference)
strategy_stop.trigger: fully closed M15 Close < current M15 EMA21 (strict; wicks ignored)

take_profits.activation: resting limit orders filled by shared WickFillMode (high >= level)
take_profits.allocation: TP1 = 1/3 of original, TP2 = 1/2 of remainder, TP3 = exact remainder
